How to add an email signature in Outlook

New Outlook (Microsoft 365)

  1. Copy your signature with Copy signature on the generator page.
  2. Open Outlook Settings → Accounts → Signatures.
  3. Create a new signature, paste into the editor, and save.

Classic Outlook on Windows

  1. Use Copy HTML source if rich paste fails.
  2. Close Outlook. Open %appdata%\Microsoft\Signatures and edit the .htm file for your signature in Notepad.
  3. Replace the file contents with the copied HTML, save, and restart Outlook.
